# Review reminders

## Get the PR ready for review

Comment on each open docs PR after the placeholder PR deadline and before
the ready-for-review deadline.

```text
Hello KEP and docs owners! <future release> Docs team here.

Please take a look at [Documenting for a release: PR ready for review](https://kubernetes.io/docs/contribute/new-content/new-features/#pr-ready-for-review) to get your PR ready for review before <docs PRs ready for review deadline, date and time zone>.

Thank you!
```

## Get the PR reviewed

Comment on each open docs PR after the ready-for-review deadline.

```text
Hello KEP and docs owners! <future release> Docs team here.

A friendly reminder that this PR needs a docs review by <Docs Freeze deadline, date and time zone> to get into the release. Please reach out to the required SIGs to get their review.

Thank you!
```

## Request a technical review

Comment on the PR and ping the KEP reviewers and approvers listed in the
KEP's `kep.yaml`, or the SIG owners.

```text
Hello KEP owners! <future release> Docs team here.

Please provide a technical review for this PR by <Docs Freeze deadline, date and time zone> to get it into the release.

Thank you!
```
